cardSummary: A beginner-friendly crypto and DeFi extension that explains mechanisms while keeping fraud, custody, and irreversibility risks explicit.

disclosures.title: Educational Content Only
disclosures.body: For educational and informational purposes only. This material is not investment advice or a recommendation. Trading and investing involve risk, including possible loss of principal.

disclosures.title: Crypto And DeFi Risk Warning
disclosures.body: Digital-asset and DeFi activity can involve extreme volatility, irreversible transactions, custody loss, smart-contract failure, operational error, and fraud risk. This material is educational only and is not a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any instrument.

disclosures.title: Anti-Impersonation Notice
disclosures.body: TradeQuip does not provide personalized investment recommendations through unsolicited calls, texts, DMs, or group chats, and will never ask users to send funds, crypto assets, passwords, seed phrases, or verification codes through those channels. Verify all communications through official channels before taking action.
